referents.why: Interrogative 'What' (neuter singular) opens the question 'what if'; it refers to no candidate.
'Some' (masculine plural indefinite) is some of the people of 3:1-2; no candidate is a masculine plural person.
'Their' (third masculine plural) refers back to 'some' (w4), a slot and not a candidate; no candidate is masculine plural.
referents.category: pronoun pointing to an unoffered slot

links.why: The condition cl1 ('if some disbelieved') is governed by the next clause cl2, not by the frame cl0 'What if?'.
A Greek 'if' precedes what it governs: 'if some disbelieved, will their unbelief nullify God's faithfulness?' The host is cl2.
cl1 is the condition, not a reason for the frame.

groups.why: The consequence of the condition is the question cl2, not the frame cl0.

cant_tell.why: 'For' gives a reason, but the form does not say what this objection is the reason for; no link added.
